column1: # AUTHORED. The runs the detection-space panels draw, one per rung of the control ladder.
# Each is a real run of the cohort, chosen to span what a column of samples.png can contain
# rather than to flatter the method; the ladder runs from a library with one organism in it
# to a field sample with eleven.
# `expect` is what the run SHOULD show if the floors behave, written before reading the
# result, so the panel can be read as a test rather than as an illustration.
